behaviour: Make CardExtension resilient when rendered outside a Backstage AppContext by falling back to Progress from @backstage/core-components when useApp() throws.
rules: 1. Import Progress as DefaultProgress alongside InfoCard from @backstage/core-components.

2. In CardExtension, initialize let Progress: React.ComponentType = DefaultProgress and wrap const app = useApp(); Progress = app.getComponents().Progress; in a try/catch block so rendering outside an AppContext uses DefaultProgress instead of throwing.
3. Preserve all existing props, Suspense fallbacks, SettingsModal behavior, and public exports.

sites.rule: Import Progress as DefaultProgress alongside InfoCard from @backstage/core-components.
Obtain Progress from useApp().getComponents().Progress inside a try/catch block and fall back to DefaultProgress when useApp() throws.

behaviour: Unit tests verifying CardExtension and createCardExtension render without throwing when no Backstage AppContext is present.
rules: 1. Include the 2026 Backstage Apache-2.0 license header at the top of the file.
2. Import only from packages declared in plugins/home-react/package.json (react, react-dom/client, @backstage/core-plugin-api, and ./extensions) so lint and knip checks pass.
3. Use createRoot from react-dom/client and act from react to mount components into a DOM container created in beforeEach and cleaned up in afterEach.

4. Verify CardExtension renders its title and Content without throwing when no AppContext is present, and verify an extension created with createPlugin({ id: 'test' }).provide(createCardExtension(...)) resolves its lazy component and renders without throwing outside an AppContext.

style_from.reason: Follows Backstage Jest unit test file structure and license header.

uses.reason: Tests createCardExtension and CardExtension defined in extensions.tsx.

tests.name: renders CardExtension without AppContext
tests.given: CardExtension is rendered with a title and Content component outside any Backstage AppContext
tests.expect: It falls back to the default Progress component and renders the card title and content without throwing

tests.name: renders a card created with createCardExtension without AppContext
tests.given: A card extension created via plugin.provide(createCardExtension({ title, components })) is rendered outside any Backstage AppContext
tests.expect: It resolves the lazy component parts and renders the card title and content without throwing
